Job Description: 
 P latform Engineer 

   

 ABOUT UPBOUND   

 Upbound Group, Inc. (effective February 27, 2023: NASDAQ: UPBD) is an omni-channel platform company committed to elevating financial opportunity for all through innovative, inclusive, and technology-driven financial solutions that address the evolving needs and aspirations of consumers. The Company’s customer-facing operating units include industry-leading brands such as   Acima,   Rent-A-Center,   and Brigit   that facilitate consumer transactions across a wide range of store-based and digital retail channels, including over 2,400 company branded retail units across the United States, Mexico and Puerto Rico.   Upbound Group, Inc. is headquartered in Plano, Texas.   

   

 JOB SUMMARY   

 The Platform Engineer II is a lead individual contributor responsible for driving the development, maintenance, and evolution of the company's Internal Developer Platform, cloud infrastructure, identity services, event-driven architecture, and AI-powered engineering capabilities.   

 
 This individual leads the design and implementation of scalable platform solutions across cloud environments,   establishes   engineering standards and best practices, and serves as a key technical advisor to engineering teams. The role partners closely with Development, Security, Architecture, and   DevEx   teams to improve developer productivity, platform reliability, and software delivery velocity.   

 
 A significant focus of this role is building and operating AI-powered platform capabilities, including LLM-based automation, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, and developer experience enhancements integrated throughout the SDLC. The engineer will also drive enterprise adoption of modern identity platforms and event-driven architectures supporting both customer-facing and internal engineering systems.    

 
 K EY RESPONSIBILITIES   

 
 Platform Engineering   

 Lead the design, implementation, and management of scalable,   highly available , and secure platform services across AWS and GCP.   

 
 Drive Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ) adoption through reusable Terraform modules, automation frameworks, and platform standards.   

 
 Architect and implement advanced CI/CD pipelines leveraging   GitOps   principles, progressive delivery, and engineering automation.   

 
 Design and   operate   platform observability solutions encompassing monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SLO management.   

 
 Provide expert-level troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for critical platform incidents.   

 
 Mentor engineers and   establish   engineering best practices across development and platform teams.   

 
 
 Developer Experience & Internal Platforms   

 Design and evolve the Internal Developer Platform, including developer self-service capabilities, platform APIs, golden path templates, service scaffolding, and Developer Portal experiences.   

 
 Define and measure platform adoption through DORA metrics, developer productivity metrics, and platform usage analytics.   

 

 Build reusable platform services, SDKs, APIs, CLIs, and automation frameworks that improve engineering efficiency.   

 
 
 Identity & Security Platforms   

 Design, implement, and   operate   enterprise identity services supporting workforce, customer, and machine-to-machine authentication.   

 
 Partner with security teams to implement authentication, authorization, federation, RBAC, and governance standards.   

 
 Lead adoption and operational excellence of identity platforms including   Keycloak   and Entra ID.   

 
 
 Event-Driven Architecture   

 Design and   operate   Kafka-based messaging and event streaming platforms.   

 
 Establish platform standards for event-driven architecture, schema management, resiliency patterns, and event governance.   

 
 Partner with application teams to build scalable asynchronous architectures   utilizing   event streaming technologies.   

 
 
 AI Platform Engineering   

 Design, build, and   operate   AI-powered platform services integrated into the software development lifecycle.   

 
 Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and agent-based workflows that interact with enterprise systems such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence, CI/CD systems, and observability platforms.   

 
 Implement MCP-based integrations and AI tooling that enable safe and efficient automation of engineering workflows.   

 
 Build AI-powered developer experiences including engineering copilots, automation assistants, deployment assistants, and developer productivity tooling.   

 
 Design guardrails, evaluation frameworks,   approval   workflows, and observability solutions for AI systems.   

 
 Instrument and   monitor   AI applications using metrics for latency, token usage,   retrieval   quality, hallucination rates, user feedback, and operational effectiveness.   

 
   

 R EQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS   

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.   

 
 6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Software Engineering.   

 

 2+ years of hands-on experience building, deploying, or operating AI/LLM-powered solutions.   

 
 Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production applications, APIs, services, or developer tooling.   

 
 Proficiency   in Python, Go, or equivalent programming languages used for platform and automation development.   

 
 Deep   expertise   with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms.   

 
 Expert knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native infrastructure patterns.   

 
 Expert-level experience with Terraform and infrastructure automation.   

 
 Extensive experience implementing advanced CI/CD pipelines and   GitOps   workflows.   

 
 
 Identity & Security   

 Hands-on experience with   Keycloak , Entra ID, Auth0, or comparable identity platforms.   

 
 Strong understanding of OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, JWTs, RBAC, and enterprise identity architectures.   

 
 
 Event Streaming   

 Production experience operating Kafka or enterprise event-streaming platforms.   

 
 Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, consumer scalability, partitioning, replication, resiliency patterns, and schema governance.   

 
 
 AI & Developer Productivity   

 Experience designing and deploying RAG-based solutions.   

 
 Understanding of   embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and context retrieval techniques.   

 
 Experience building AI agents, tool-calling frameworks, or agentic workflows.   

 
 Hands-on experience integrating LLMs with engineering workflows, source control platforms, ticketing systems, or operational tooling.   

 
 Experience implementing MCP server integrations or equivalent AI tool integration frameworks.   

 
 Experience evaluating,   monitoring , and improving AI system performance in production environments.   

 

 Understanding of   AI governance, guardrails, validation strategies, and human-in-the-loop workflows.   

 
 
 PREFERRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS   

 Experience productionizing agentic systems with permissions, auditability, rollback strategies, failure handling, and human approval workflows.   

 
 Experience integrating AI systems across multiple enterprise engineering platforms, such as GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Backstage, in a governed production environment.   

 
 Familiarity with   LangGraph ,   CrewAI , Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agent Framework, or similar orchestration frameworks.   

 
 Experience building automated AI evaluation pipelines, benchmark datasets, regression tests, and continuous quality feedback loops.   

 
 Experience building Backstage-based or equivalent Developer Portals with catalog ownership, software templates, scorecards, and   adoption   metrics.   

 
 Experience using engineering productivity data to   identify   platform friction, prioritize improvements, and measure developer experience outcomes.   

 
 Experience supporting regulated environments and security compliance frameworks.   

 
 
 COMPENSATION/BENEFITS   

 Competitive compensation    

 
 Full health benefits-Medical/Dental/Vision    

 
 401(k) match, (5%/4%)    

 
 DTO (discretionary time off)    

 
 Health savings account (HSA) with company contribution    

 
 College tuition reimbursement program (STEM degrees)    

 
 Unlimited use of LinkedIn Learning    

 
 On-site gym and showers   

 
 Free car charging and covered parking   

 
 
 SPONSORSHIP 
 Applicants must   be authorized to   work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa   at this time .   
 


 Join us at the forefront of digital innovation, where your work will directly   impact   the future of financial accessibility and consumer experiences across retail,   e ‑ commerce , and fintech.   

 
 Upbound/Acima/Brigit are equal opportunity employers committed to ensuring that all employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis, and without regard to actual or perceived race .     

 
 

 Upbound Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
